For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Presets stripe

The reality is that Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195 globally, leaving vast areas of the world underserved. When creators in restricted countries try to sell digital products, they often encounter not just payment processing barriers but also the risk of account suspensions that hold funds for up to 180 days. This situation creates instability and uncertainty for creators who rely on these platforms. Sovereign commerce infrastructure addresses this issue by providing a robust alternative, allowing creators to maintain full ownership and control over their sales process without the looming threat of account restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Sovereign commerce infrastructure operates on a base-layer [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-ebooks-without-paypal-stripe-7|COREMERCH guide to architecture]] that consists of free and paid tools seamlessly integrated to provide a functional online store. For instance, Coremerch uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, enabling creators to deploy their stores quickly. Back-end logic is managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring efficient processing of orders. Meanwhile, payment verification is handled by NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring that transactions are not only secure but also affordable. This architecture eliminates reliance on traditional payment platforms, allowing creators to operate independently.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where mainstream payment processing services are unavailable or highly restricted. Whether you are selling presets, ebooks, or courses, this infrastructure is tailored to meet your needs. It empowers creators to establish their own online stores without the constraints imposed by platforms like PayPal or Stripe. This is not just about bypassing restrictions; it's about creating a sustainable and independent business model that fosters growth and resilience in the face of financial isolation.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you complete control over your sales process.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack consists of several key components that work harmoniously to create a reliable sales environment. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the foundation for hosting digital products, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script ensure robust back-end functionality. Supabase or Google Sheets handle order storage, allowing for efficient management of customer transactions. Additionally, NOWPayments streamlines payment processing with minimal fees and no KYC requirements. Together, these components form a cohesive system that empowers creators to manage their online storefronts efficiently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start deploying your sovereign commerce infrastructure today, first, choose between the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack, depending on your needs. Set up your hosting environment using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, followed by implementing back-end logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Next, integrate order management with Supabase or Google Sheets, and finally, connect to NOWPayments for seamless payment processing. This infrastructure can be deployed in as little as 48 hours, providing you with a fully operational online store.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you can sell digital products using sovereign commerce infrastructure. By leveraging platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, coupled with NOWPayments for payment processing, you can create a fully functional online store. This approach ensures you maintain control over your products and sales without relying on conventional payment platforms.
No subscriptions or hidden fees — you own everything.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Many creators search for alternatives to Gumroad when faced with restrictions. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a viable solution. You can explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, where you can find tools designed specifically for creators in regions where traditional platforms fail.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?
You can use a sovereign commerce stack that includes GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. This allows you to create an independent online store without relying on Stripe.
What is the best alternative to Gumroad for creators in restricted countries?

The best alternative is to implement a sovereign commerce infrastructure stack, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, which allows for seamless integration of hosting, order management, and payment processing.
Can I use PayPal if I am in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan?
PayPal is often unavailable or restricted in these countries. Instead, consider using NOWPayments with a sovereign commerce setup to process transactions without the limitations of PayPal.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction and does not require KYC or buyer accounts, making it an ideal solution for creators in underserved regions.
How do I get started with my online store?
Begin by choosing a sovereign commerce stack. Deploy it using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, then set up payment processing through NOWPayments to start selling your digital products.
